task.title: P6-110: Add soft deletion to collections, filter every read path
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-110. Size: M. Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md, specs/data-model.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Add soft deletion to `collections` and filter it out of every read path — deliberately inert, changing no behavior.** Step 2 of specs/collection-deletion.md. Migration `0010_collection_soft_delete.sql`: `ALTER TABLE collections ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz` plus a partial index `collections_user_parent_live_idx ON collections (user_id, parent_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`. Expand-only, safe to apply ahead of the code. Then add `deleted_at IS NULL` to every site that reads collections, holdings or desires: the single collapsed "owned" source from `P6-039`, plus `collection_tree`, `list_collections`, `require_owned_collection`, `inbox_id`, `needs`, `suggested_destinations` and `search`'s ownership read. `require_owned_collection` must fail for a soft-deleted collection exactly as it does for a non-existent one, so a hidden collection can never be a move destination or a write target. **Nothing sets `deleted_at` in this task**, so every filter is a no-op and the risky half lands under no time pressure. The `ON DELETE CASCADE` on `parent_id`/`holdings`/`desires`/`card_tags` and the `ON DELETE SET NULL` on the two `moves` columns all stay — soft delete simply never fires them, which is what stops the ledger falsifying. **Acceptance:** the gate is green and no user-visible behavior changes; a manually soft-deleted row disappears from every screen and is refused as a move destination. **Prereq: `P6-039`.**
